title: Immunomodulatory effects of arborside C pentaacetate- an iridoid glycoside acetate isolated from Nyctanthes arbor-tristis Linn. and in vitro and in silico studies.
authors: Sana, Talea; Malik, Hira Noor; Shah, Syeda Farah; Zia, Komal; Siddiqui, Bina S; Ul-Haq, Zaheer; Begum, Sabira; B Hadda, Taibi; Jabeen, Almas
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物来源化合物的免疫调节作用，仅含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Following a bio-assay guided fractionation and chromatographic separations a known compound arborside C pentaacetate was isolated. Immunomodulatory effects of arborside C pentaacetate were revealed by inhibition of NO, pro-inflammatory mediators, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and NF-kappaB at translational level in an in vitro study. The docking results revealed that arborside C pentaacetate bind strongly to the target protein with the docking score of -10.38 kcal/mol. The compound was non-toxic on normal human fibroblast (BJ) and THP-1 cells and, could be a potential therapeutic agent in inflammation driven diseases.
abstract_zh: 经生物测定引导的分级分离及色谱分离后，分离得到一种已知化合物arborside C五乙酸酯。体外研究表明，arborside C五乙酸酯通过抑制NO、促炎介质、IL-6、TNF-α及NF-kappaB在翻译水平上发挥免疫调节作用。对接结果显示，arborside C五乙酸酯与靶蛋白强烈结合，对接评分为-10.38 kcal/mol。该化合物对正常人成纤维细胞（BJ）和THP-1细胞无毒性，可能成为炎症驱动疾病的潜在治疗药物。
